newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Orbotech a strong buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Orbotech a strong buy.

text.p: Salomon Brothers upgraded its 1997 and 1998 earnings estimates for Israel's Orbotech Ltd, a maker of automated optical inspection (AOI) systems for printed circuit boards (PCBs), and maintained its strong buy rating.
"We believe that Orbotech continues to demonstrate strong operating performance in most of its sectors," said analyst Victor Halpert in a report.
"(The) pace and acceptance of new products over the next few quarters will further increase the diversity of the company's revenue base," he said.
The report said earnings per share (EPS) were expected to reach $1.79 this year and $2.00 next year compared with previous forecasts of of $1.73 and $1.96.
It also increased the company's 1997 revenue estimate to $175.5 million from $167.3 million.

The report said Orbotech was expected to use cash proceeds from the sale of its Opal affiliate relatively soon for acquisitions. This, Salomon said, would offset the impact of lost revenues from Opal.

"Orbotech shares continue to trade at highly attractive levels of 10.9 times 1997 and 9.7 times 1998 EPS," Halpert said. "We are upgrading our 12-month target price range from $22-25 to $27-30 level."
